scope: Real PostAge actor and archive client recovery; partial local coverage, not full l1-null-receipts equivalence.

product_bug.trigger: Archive accepts the HTTP seed request but never answers before any post is known.
product_bug.effect: The inline seed await prevents follower input consumption, metric publication, liveness checks, and input-close shutdown.
product_bug.evidence: post_age.rs is unchanged between main 0b83255b7e6489bee2289eb9207aef34f1265751 and integration f48610979e9902d7b6da83fb444436b84876fb4d. No causal link to current integration CI failures is established.

red_proof.scope: Original inline-seed implementation with only the private input seam added. The real HTTP peer receives the request before Tokio time pauses.

implementation.ownership: PostAge owns at most one archive read task; owner destruction aborts it.
implementation.deadline: The entire status, batch and L1-block RPC sequence shares the existing observation interval, ten seconds in service wiring.
implementation.ordering: Live input and timer ticks continue during the read. Completion publishes immediately. The monotone timestamp rule rejects an older seed after a newer live post.
implementation.retry: Failures clear the pending attempt; a later timer tick can retry while no last post is known. Incoming follower records do not cancel or restart the pending request.
implementation.wiring: Private generic decoded-record seam; production still uses the original Aeron subscriber and constructor parameters. No events.rs change.
implementation.hot_path: Observability startup/recovery gains at most one owned task. Transaction posting and receipt timeout code are unchanged. No deployed throughput or latency claim.

batcher_library.note: The two ignored hidden-receipt checks pass separately through the component runner. The last fixture change only replaces for_each with a for loop for Clippy; all nine PostAge checks were rerun after it.

style.note: The existing proc-macro-error2 future-incompatibility notice remains; no new Clippy warning.

limits: Follower input starts at the decoded record boundary; no Aeron discovery or fleet transport proof.
Real HTTP and JSON-RPC decoding are exercised. Tokio time advances deadlines and scheduling only after each request reaches the peer. Post-age uses real wall time.
No Prometheus scraping/alert evaluation, lifecycle-output assertion, Nomad restart, EigenDA or client transaction progress proof.
No full local chaos case marked complete; catalog remains 39 partial and 41 planned of 80.
No distributed qualification credit; 10 consecutive fresh full rounds on an unchanged final SHA are still required for a flakiness-fixed claim.

style_review.R1: Comments describe current invariants; corrected receipt-confirmation claims do not change chaos assertions.
style_review.R2-R3: Helpers and sibling test files keep functions and files within bounds.
style_review.R4-R5: Owned tasks abort on owner exit; bounded channels coordinate real peers without mutexes. Named ownership helpers close senders.
style_review.R6-R8: Private generic input trait, no new dynamic dispatch or public API.
style_review.R9-R13: One pending task is explicit actor state. Checked clock arithmetic in fixtures; existing interval reused; Clippy passes.
style_review.R14-R16: Shared fixture and server use named methods. Registration loop contains one call chain. Production inputs and side-effect ordering are reviewed.
